description_en: Creates a data synchronization task to synchronize data from a feature view's offline table to its online store
description_zh: 创建特征视图的数据同步任务，把离线表数据同步到对应的在线存储
kebab_example: aliyun paifeaturestore publish-feature-view-table --instance-id fs-cn-00000000 --feature-view-id 3 --partitions key=example-string --biz-mode Overwrite --event-time 2021-12-15T23:24:33.132+08:00 --config example-string --offline-to-online true --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishFeatureViewTable

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. Call the `ListInstances` operation to get this ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the feature view. Call the `ListFeatureViews` operation to get this ID
parameters.help_zh: 特征视图ID，可从接口ListFeatureViews获取
parameters.name: feature_view_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization mode. The following values are supported:

- `Overwrite`: Overwrites all data in the specified partitions.

- `Merge`: Merges the new data with existing data in the specified partitions
parameters.help_zh:
模式，包括以下可选值：

- Overwrite：覆盖写
- Merge：合并
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The event time of the data to be published, in ISO 8601 format
parameters.name: event_time

parameters.help_en: Custom configurations for the task, provided as a JSON string
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronize data from the offline table to the online store
parameters.name: offline_to_online
